tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything. Dark is the default theme, matching the logo.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, the site header, quiz panels and callout bodies.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Quiz options and hovered cards inside a surface; menus.

tokens.name: surface-code
tokens.usage: Code blocks and inline code.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card outlines. Never the only boundary of a control: use border-strong.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Boundaries of controls: quiz options, inputs, secondary buttons. At least 3:1 on bg, surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on bg, surface, surface-raised, surface-code and every *-subtle fill (14:1 or more).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, captions, timestamps and source names on bg, surface, surface-raised, surface-code and amber-subtle (6.3:1 or more).

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: The logo colour. Primary buttons, progress fills, the active-nav underline and highlights. Never text on a light ground (1.8:1 on white): use accent-text.

tokens.name: amber-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered primary buttons.

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Text and icons on amber and amber-hover (10:1 or more).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and amber-coloured words on bg, surface, surface-raised, surface-code and amber-subtle (5.6:1 or more).

tokens.name: amber-subtle
tokens.usage: Selected quiz option, the key-takeaways panel, the current lesson in a list.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid outline, 2px offset, on every focusable element. 5.6:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Correct-answer icon, label and border on surface and success-subtle. Always with the word Correct and a check icon: it is not told apart from danger by lightness.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of a correct quiz option and the Tip callout.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Wrong-answer icon, label and border on surface and danger-subtle. Always with words and a cross icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of a wrong quiz option and the Watch out callout.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Note callout icon and title on info-subtle (5.9:1 or more); the Research news tag.

tokens.name: info-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of the Note callout.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: One per page: the lesson or page title. 30px below 640px wide.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Gemini adds a new reasoning mode
styles.usage: News and resource card titles, quiz questions.

styles.name: lesson
styles.sample: A token is a chunk of text the model reads as one piece.
styles.usage: Lesson prose, at most measure-lesson wide.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Each item links to its original source.
styles.usage: Everything outside lessons: summaries, explanations, UI copy.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.sample: Correct: tokens, not words, set the price.
styles.usage: Quiz feedback verdicts and short emphasis.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Figure 2: one sentence split into tokens
styles.usage: Figure captions and footnotes; the smallest text on the site.

styles.name: code-small
styles.usage: Inline code inside small text, token IDs in diagrams.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tag padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a control; tag padding (horizontal).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between quiz options and between metadata items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; the page gutter below 640px.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between cards; the page gutter from 640px.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above an h2 in a lesson.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Above the footer; hero padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, inline code, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, quiz options, code blocks, callouts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Progress bars and filter chips.

shadow.note: Borders separate things; shadows are only for floating layers.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and the mobile nav sheet. Never on cards.

layout.note: Fixed sizes the layout is built around.

tokens.name: measure-lesson
tokens.usage: Max width of lesson prose and quizzes (about 75 characters at the lesson style).

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the page container.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Site header height; 56px below 640px wide.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: ad-slot-inline
tokens.usage: Reserved height of an in-article ad slot, held empty from launch so turning ads on never shifts the layout.
